thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] eu-west-1 realtime alert: p99 latency (1m) for /v1/stream = 2.8s (SLO 1.5s). Auto-page: oncall.

sre_oncall: ack — joining bridge now. Anyone seeing deploys or config changes?

maya (prod-ops): no infra deploys in last 30m. We did roll a model variant to eu-west ~12h ago (canary finished).

jordan (eng-runtime): quick check on dashboards. Running a small probe: 
```
GET /internal/metrics?region=eu-west&window=1m
// output snippet
p95=820ms p99=2.8s errors=3.1% streaming_tail_events=high
```

sre_oncall: customer impact? are we returning errors or just slow tails?

sam (support): @sre_oncall a couple enterprise customers pinged CS with slow streaming responses and one 502 from EU last 10m. No major outage reports yet.

leon (eng-ml): we launched quantized weights (q4) to eu-west last night for the 13B family. Could be kv-cache interaction with quant changes.

jordan (eng-runtime): investigating KV cache metrics — hitrate dropped from ~98% to ~60% on the large sequence lanes starting ~5961231000. Memory eviction spikes observed.

sre_oncall: ok, mitigation plan: 1) shift traffic to fallback lighter variant 2) reduce max_batch_size on eu-west workers 3) enable prefix-only cache mode. Any objections?

maya (prod-ops): initiating fallback route now to rwd-13b-v2-lowlat for new streaming sessions. Rolling 50% -> 100% if p99 improves.

jordan (eng-runtime): deploying batch size patch to eu-west pool: max_batch_size 64 -> 16. Patch applied (deploy id abc123).

incident-bot: action logged: route-change by maya (prod-ops); runtime-patch by jordan (eng-runtime), commit abc123.

leon (eng-ml): also can we temporarily bump cache TTL to avoid churn? I'll open a quick config: cache_ttl +30s for streaming lanes.

sre_oncall: please do. Also start sampling long traces for p99 (trace ids -> /traces?id=...).

jordan (eng-runtime): cache_ttl bumped +30s. Enabling prefix-only mode for KV to prioritize reuse.

10m later
sre_oncall: monitoring: p99 dropped to ~1.2s after fallback + batch reduction. errors down to 0.8%. Streaming tail events decreased.

maya (prod-ops): rollback of fallback not yet — keep 50% traffic on lowlat until morning metrics look stable.

sam (support): notified the customers that were affected with a brief update. No escalations.

jordan (eng-runtime): root cause hypothesis: quantized model + cache pressure caused frequent KV eviction and long cache-miss downstream lookups, amplifying tail latency. Need deeper postmortem.

sre_oncall: agreed. For now: mitigation=active (fallback + batch reduce + TTL bump). We'll open an incident ticket and assign owners for postmortem (runtime+ml+prod-ops).

leon (eng-ml): I'll capture model rollout artifacts and config diff.

maya (prod-ops): I'll prepare rollback plan for the q4 rollout and a staged reintroduction with tighter cache thresholds.

sre_oncall: thanks — closing page for live mitigation. Continue watch for 30m, then hand to runbook owners for follow-up. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident ticket created: INC-596123 (status: mitigated -> monitoring).
